description: This file defines the MainActivity class, which is the main entry point of the Android application. It sets up the UI components such as the bottom navigation, toolbar, and floating action button, and manages fragment transactions for different sections of the app like Home, Categories, Favorites, and Profile.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main activity hosting tid navigation tabs and a button to add recipes, managing different fragments for each section.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and handles initial fragment loading.

methods.name: onNavSelected
methods.description: Handles navigation item selection, replacing the main fragment container with the selected section's fragment.
